sentence_stem: Although the article claimed to be entirely objective,
correct_completion: its author had received funding from the company it evaluated.
full_sentence: Although the article claimed to be entirely objective, its author had received funding from the company it evaluated.
acceptable_variants: the author had close ties to the industry under review.
several of its sources had a clear financial interest.

options.text: so readers trusted its conclusions completely.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'although' requires a contrast with the first clause.

options.text: its author had received funding from the company it evaluated.
the article was published in a national newspaper.
options.why_wrong: This adds neutral information but does not contrast with the claim of objectivity.

options.text: because the editors were very careful.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' signals cause and clashes with 'although', which signals contrast.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' in news and report writing
explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. Here the claim of objectivity is contradicted by a financial link, which is the kind of concession that critical readers look for in reports.
translation: Aunque el artículo afirmaba ser totalmente objetivo, su autor había recibido financiación de la empresa que evaluaba.
